summary: Report an advisory ETA in a work progress note

replay.detail: ETA uses the existing progress summary claim and its history. Replay behavior is unchanged.

schema.detail: No replicated vocabulary, database, projection or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: The current work progress authority and lease checks remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: work progress accepts --eta with a positive duration or future RFC3339 timestamp. It adds an absolute UTC ETA and report time to the summary, readable by existing clients. The next nonempty summary replaces it; supplying --summary without --eta withdraws it. Progress without a nonempty summary keeps the existing note.

downtime.detail: Only the reporting CLI needs the new flag. Existing daemons and readers accept the progress note.

manual.detail: No configuration or migration is needed. ETA is advisory and does not change execution budgets, waits or leases.

recovery.detail: The existing durable progress history and replay preserve the note. A missed estimate does not fail work.
